h1_emph: Auto repair in Kannapolis, done properly.
hero_lede: Muffler shop on 720 Rainbow Dr in Kannapolis. Recent jobs are on the photos page.
coverage_h2: Kannapolis, and the towns around it
about_p1: We handle auto repair for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, tires and wheels, exhaust and underbody. 215 customers have left us a review, averaging 4.9 out of 5. We work out of Kannapolis and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Steve t
reviews.text: I was recommended to this location and was very satisfied. The service,the priceand the finished result were greater then anticipated. I will recommend this shop to anyone in need of some custom and traditional exhaust work.

reviews.author: Rachel Levi
reviews.text: I was extremely pleased with the quick and friendly service I received getting my car inspected here. I am relatively new to town and this place was highly recommended and has great reviews, which I find to be greatly deserved. They were very nice and I was in and out in about 15 minutes. Will definitely be back next time inspection is due or if I’m ever in need of any other car services.
